title: Allez Up

services.name: Climbing 101
services.desc: The main goal of the Discovery Groups is to introduce children to climbing through both theoretical and practical learning activities. In a safe, fun, and dynamic environment, participants are introduced to bouldering. Our experienced instructors encourage kids to challenge themselves and develop new skills that will benefit them both in climbing and in their everyday lives. At Allez Up, we believe that children are more likely to develop a lifelong passion for sports when they have the opportunity to explore a wide variety of physical activities. That's why we foster supportive youth groups built on teamwork and kindness, where everyone feels comfortable learning, expressing themselves,
